reasoning.summary: 16 votes across 11 generations reveal a clear fitness landscape. The dominant signal is gen_014_b_explore_horizontal at 5/5 global_fitness — the highest single score in the entire dataset — yet it has never been exploited. Gen_010_explore_focus (4/5) remains the second-highest and the most statistically reliable high-fitness anchor (its topology proved robust across palette variants in Gen 017/018). The palette experiments in Gen 018 A (cold slate, avg 3.0) confirmed that palette swaps alone do not improve fitness — topology is the primary variable. Gen 018 B exposed a critical anti-pattern: removing the sidebar causes editorial density collapse (scored 1/5). The rejection corpus is now well-defined: visual chaos (016 A/B), responsive-only layouts (013 A), and full-width terminal dispatch without structure (018 B) all fail. Gen 015 B's high variance (5,1,2) marks the terminal-density cluster as unreliable. Two trajectories are live: exploit the proven gen_010 topology with corrected density, or explore the unresolved gen_014_b horizontal hypothesis with a guardrail against density collapse.
reasoning.exploit_vs_explore_decision: EXPLORE, with one exploit arm. The gen_014_b 5/5 signal is from a single vote — statistically insufficient for pure exploitation, but too strong to suppress. The explore arm targets a horizontal timeline topology derived from gen_014_b, but constrained by the editorial density lesson from gen_018_b: a persistent vertical sidebar or anchor column MUST be maintained to prevent density collapse. The exploit arm deepens the proven gen_010 focus topology (single-column / 70-30) with higher editorial density to test whether density increase alone can push it past 4/5.
reasoning.statistical_note: 16 votes across 11 generations. Sample size remains small. The 5/5 for gen_014_b is a single-vote outlier and cannot be treated as a statistically confirmed mean. The most reliable high-fitness datum is gen_010 (n=1, 4/5) confirmed consistent across palette derivatives. Exploitation should wait until gen_014_b receives at least 3 votes. Gen_015_b is flagged as high-variance (σ=1.70) and excluded from blend sources.

editorial_density.note: CRITICAL CONSTRAINT. Gen 018 B scored 1/5 for removing the sidebar — editorial density collapsed. Any new topology MUST preserve a structured information column (sidebar or equivalent anchor zone) to maintain density. Target 4/5: dense but not overwhelming. Gen 014 A scored 1/5 for sparseness. The Operator explicitly wants richly packed layouts.

structure.note: Test a hybrid structure: primary reading axis is horizontal (timeline scrub, as in gen_014_b), but a persistent vertical sidebar anchors editorial density. This avoids the full-width terminal trap of gen_018_b while exploring the horizontal topology that scored 5/5.

tone.note: No direct high-signal votes on tone. Hold at calibrated neutral — neither robotic sterility nor theatrical excess. The content should feel like precision editorial intelligence, not performance.

form.note: No direct votes. Maintain clean typographic rhythm. The form must support density without creating visual noise — tight leading, clear hierarchy, restrained use of weight variation.

topology.note: PRIMARY MUTATION VECTOR. Gen 014 B's horizontal timeline topology is the highest-scored untested topology in the dataset (5/5, n=1). The explore arm MUST implement a true horizontal scroll/timeline axis as the primary reading topology. The exploit arm deepens gen_010's proven single-column/70-30 vertical topology with higher content density. Do NOT replicate the terminal-split topology of gen_015_b (high variance, excluded).

visual_entropy.note: Hold the low-entropy discipline established by MR-001. Gen 016 A/B confirmed that visual chaos is terminal for fitness. Maintain muted palette, restrained contrast, no neon accents. The palette itself is now confirmed neutral — do not spend mutation budget on palette experimentation this cycle.

aesthetics.note: The 'Focused Warmth' aesthetic from gen_017_a has 0 votes — no signal yet. For the exploit arm, carry forward the Dark Sepia / Bloomberg fusion. For the explore arm targeting horizontal topology, consider a cartographic or timeline-map aesthetic — structured, dense, legible, referencing archival newspaper front pages or editorial broadsheet layouts.

interaction_mechanics.note: The horizontal topology demands deliberate interaction design. The explore arm must define: how does horizontal scrubbing work? Is it auto-advancing, swipe-driven, or click-stepped? Ensure the interaction mechanics support editorial density (items should not disappear during scroll — they should compress or layer). The exploit arm holds current click/modal mechanics.

global_fitness.note: Current ceiling is 5/5 (gen_014_b, n=1, unconfirmed) and reliable peak is 4/5 (gen_010). The goal is to either confirm the 5/5 ceiling with the horizontal topology or push the exploit arm past 4/5 by adding density to the proven focus topology. Either result advances the fitness map.

ui_directives.layout: EXPLORE arm: horizontal timeline axis as primary reading flow, with a persistent vertical sidebar (min 25% viewport width) anchoring editorial density and navigation. The sidebar must not collapse or disappear at any breakpoint. EXPLOIT arm: deepen gen_010's asymmetric 2-column (70/30) vertical layout with higher information density in the primary column — more dispatch items, tighter spacing, richer metadata per item.
ui_directives.palette: Palette is a confirmed neutral variable — do not experiment with palette this cycle. Both arms default to the warm neutral / dark amber palette established in gen_010 / gen_017_a. Avoid cold palette (gen_018_a result: no improvement). Avoid high-contrast neon (gen_016 failures).
ui_directives.typography: Tight editorial grid. Primary reading type at high legibility (min 14px body, serif or high-quality sans). Dense secondary metadata in monospaced or condensed sans. No decorative typography. Section headers must be structurally functional, not theatrical.

exploit.title: Radical Focus II
exploit.description: A direct exploitation of gen_010's proven single-column / 70-30 asymmetric vertical topology. The mutation vector is editorial density: pack significantly more dispatch items into the primary column with tighter typographic spacing, richer per-item metadata (timestamps, source tags, confidence scores), and a secondary column that acts as a structured digest/summary sidebar. Palette holds at warm amber. Visual entropy holds at low. Hypothesis: density increase on a proven topology breaks the 4/5 ceiling.

explore.title: Horizontal Chronicle
explore.description: A constrained exploration of gen_014_b's horizontal timeline topology, hardened against the editorial density failure of gen_018_b. Primary reading axis is horizontal — a timeline of dispatch events that can be scrubbed or stepped through chronologically. A persistent vertical sidebar (25-30% viewport, non-collapsing) anchors density: it displays the current event's full detail, metadata, and related signals. The horizontal axis shows compressed event tiles; the sidebar surfaces depth. Aesthetic reference: archival broadsheet front page mapped onto a timeline — structured, dense, legible, not theatrical.
